ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The right side and bottom of the circuit are a common wire, which can be taken as the reference potential 0 V. The upper central node is connected leftward through a resistor R to the upper end of the power supply E1, downward through a resistor R and a milliammeter to the common bottom wire, and rightward through a resistor R to the single-pole three-throw switch S. Contact 1 of the switch is directly connected to the common wire; contact 2 is connected through a battery labeled 4 V to the right-side common wire, with its polarity making the potential of contact 2 relative to the common wire be -4 V; contact 3 is connected through a battery labeled 6 V to the right-side common wire, with its polarity making the potential of contact 3 relative to the common wire be +6 V. Reasoning: Let the switch connected-terminal voltage be Vs. According to the method given in the problem, writing KCL for the central node gives the milliammeter reading I=(E1+Vs)/(3R). At position 1, Vs=0, and the reading is 40 mA, so E1/(3R)=40 mA. At position 2, Vs=-4 V, and the reading is -60 mA, so (E1-4)/(3R)=-60 mA. Subtracting the two equations gives 4/(3R)=100 mA, so 1/(3R)=25 mA/V. At position 3, Vs=+6 V, so I3=E1/(3R)+6/(3R)=40 mA+6×25 mA=190 mA.

method.method_draft: First describe the figure: position 1 grounds the switch branch, position 2 applies -4 V to that branch, and position 3 applies +6 V, with the same series resistor R feeding the same central node and ammeter branch. Take position 1 as the baseline current, 40 mA. Moving to position 2 changes the switch-node voltage by -4 V and changes the ammeter reading from 40 mA to -60 mA, a change of -100 mA. Therefore the calibrated effect is 25 mA per volt of switch-node voltage. Position 3 is +6 V relative to the position-1 baseline, so add 6×25 mA to the 40 mA baseline to obtain the position-3 reading.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中所有电阻均标为 R。中间节点左侧通过一个电阻 R 接到电源 E1，右侧通过一个电阻 R 接到开关 S，向下通过一个电阻 R 和毫安表接到底部公共导线。右侧竖直导线与底部公共线相连，作为同一参考节点。开关位置 1 接到该公共参考节点；位置 2 通过标为 4 V 的电源支路接到参考节点；位置 3 通过标为 6 V 的电源支路接到参考节点。
推理：按题给方法，把位置 1 作为基准，此时毫安表读数为 40 mA。开关从位置 1 到位置 2 时，开关支路电压相对基准变化为 -4 V，毫安表读数从 40 mA 变为 -60 mA，读数变化为 -60 - 40 = -100 mA。因此电压变化对毫安表读数的比例为 (-100 mA)/(-4 V) = 25 mA/V。位置 3 相对位置 1 的电压变化为 +6 V，所以读数应在基准 40 mA 上增加 6 × 25 mA = 150 mA。故位置 3 时毫安表读数为 40 mA + 150 mA = 190 mA。
